Title: Azure Web PubSub support for Socket.IO now generally available

Body.Content:
To help you build real-time experiences using the Socket.IO library, Azure Web PubSub for Socket.IO has reached general availability.  This capability manages client connections for an application using the Socket.IO library.  This means you don't need to manage multiple Socket.IO servers or adapters, and you don't need to develop expertise in distributed systems - instead, you can focus on building real-time experiences.

Now you can easily migrate from self-hosted Socket.IO to a fully managed solution through Web PubSub for Socket.IO.
